text:
maria.g: quick idea — want to run a small experiment on the pricing page next week. low-risk: swap one tier label, add a micro FAQ variation, and a CTA nudge inside the calculator modal. thoughts?

jake.k: love it. can you sketch the exact changes? which tier label are we testing?

maria.g: proposed changes in the doc: https://docs.google.com/price-test (draft)
- Tier rename: 'Pro Plus' -> 'Scale' (shorter, more enterprise-y)
- FAQ add: short Q about dedicated capacity commitments and burst pricing, 2-line answer
- Calculator tweak: add a subtle "estimated monthly with autoscale" line and a small CTA: 'Contact sales for reserved pricing'

olivia: are we also changing the slug or just the visible label? slug changes add SEO ripple.

maria.g: visible label only for this test (A/B client-side). no slug change.
ravi.s: how will we route inbound leads from the calculator CTA? want to ensure sales sees them.

maria.g: plan: calculator CTA opens a short form that tags leads as "pricing-experiment-2026Q1" and routes to SFDC queue 'Inbound - Pricing Trials'. elsA_CS, can you confirm that queue exists? @elsa_cs

elsa_cs: confirmed queue exists. please add utm_campaign=pricing_probe to form links. I'll add a quick auto-note in Salesforce when the form is submitted.

jake.k: metrics to watch? conversion on calculator CTA, clickthrough on tier label hover tooltip, FAQ engagement (expand rates). Also monitor any change in support tickets about "confusing tiers".

maria.g: agreed. baseline numbers in the doc. target: +6% calc-to-contact, <2% increase in support threads.

olivia: copy tweaks: for 'Scale' can we also test a 1-line supporting blurb: "predictable throughput for apps at scale" — feels clearer than 'Pro Plus'.
maria.g: 👍 add as variant B. we'll run a three-arm test: control, label-only, label+blurb+FAQ+calc-nudge.

ravi.s: timeline?
maria.g: dev can push experiment flag on Monday (deploy-bot will post deploy). run for 10 business days, then sync Wed 2/3 for initial readout.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: pricing-microprobe feature-flag -> staging at 1719881000, prod rollout planned 1719884600 if staging smoke is good.

elsa_cs: small note — if we see sales leads spike, please make sure AE routing includes "pricing_probe" in handoff notes so reps can reference the experiment.
jake.k: will monitor via amplitude funnel and SFDC. Olivia, can you prepare two quick banners for UX (label tooltip + calculator CTA microcopy)?
olivia: on it. will drop assets in the doc by EOD Friday.
maria.g: thanks all. i'll update the doc with final variants and the win criteria. tagging @ravi.s for routing signoff before the flag goes live. :sparkles:
